verdict.rationale: Twenty documents an in-product AI chatbot that queries CRM records, summarizes them, and explains the data in natural language. Its AI agents answer questions inside the CRM, and the AI overview lists opportunity scoring based on engagement patterns, which is a form of AI-generated insight. Missing for 10: detail on proactive or unprompted suggestions beyond the single opportunity-scoring mention, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
